The main takeaway from our work is that
the IR SED is an effective tool for identifying candidate OB stars, particularly when used in conjunction with other indicators of OB-star membership, such as X-ray emission.
the combination of X-ray emission and mid-IR SED fitting is an effective tool for identifying candidate OB stars and estimating their luminosities in star-forming regions.
X-ray emission, combined with mid-IR photometry, provides an effective method for identifying OB stars in the presence of large amounts of dust extinction.
